metadata.description: Plugins for Claude Code. `pi` is unrelated to Pi Agent.

plugins.name: observational-memory
plugins.description: Observational memory beside compaction: an observer model notes what matters as the session runs, and after each compaction the notes are added after the harness's own summary; a recall tool returns the exact transcript lines behind a note

plugins.name: agent-tmux
plugins.description: Stdio MCP server that lets an agent see and lay out its own tmux session: list, capture, new windows and splits, wait for output, and type into panes it owns without pressing Enter

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode. Forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.
